backend/main.mo: Actor storing contact form submissions, validating input, and returning sorted messages by email or timestamp.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping requirements to involved frontend files, components, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of key frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme defining OKLCH industrial color variables, dark mode tokens, and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata, social share tags, and script mount point for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component composing header, marketing sections, footer, and notification system.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer with company info, quick links, contact details, and attribution link.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Header: Sticky responsive header with navigation links, mobile menu, and scroll-based styling.
frontend/src/components/marketing/sectio: About section describing company reliability, B2B focus, pricing, delivery, and value highlights.
A contact form section with validation, WhatsApp link, and submission logic using a custom hook.
Hero banner with headline, description, CTA buttons, and a large hero image.
Displays a grid of product cards with images, titles, and descriptions.
Renders feature cards highlighting key business advantages with icons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to identity changes and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Fetches all contact messages from the backend using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollToSection.ts: Utility hook to smoothly scroll and focus a section by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitContact.ts: Submits contact form data to the backend, merging phone into the message and invalidating message queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles configuring color theme, layout utilities, and accessibility rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query, identity provider, and rendering the app.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining content paths, theme extensions for colors, typography, animations, and plugins like typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Defines project requirements and state for building an industrial-themed B2B packaging website, including design guidelines, required sections, images, and implemented features.
